# fish completion for tachy
#
# Install for the current user:
#   mkdir -p ~/.config/fish/completions
#   tachy generate completions fish > ~/.config/fish/completions/tachy.fish
# (fish picks the file up on the next shell)
#
# Regenerated by hand from the CLI surface — tests/generate.d fails
# `dub test` when a command word or option is missing from here.

function __tachy_inv_args
    # the -i/--inventory value on the current command line, if any,
    # echoed back as arguments for the hosts list call
    set -l toks (commandline -opc)
    for i in (seq 2 (count $toks))
        switch $toks[$i]
            case -i --inventory
                if test $i -lt (count $toks)
                    printf '%s\n' $toks[$i] $toks[(math $i + 1)]
                end
        end
    end
end

function __tachy_candidates
    # selection candidates: all, host names, @tags — from the inventory
    # (no host is contacted), honoring -i on this command line
    tachy hosts list --completion (__tachy_inv_args) 2>/dev/null
end

function __tachy_names
    __tachy_candidates | string match -v -r '^@' | string match -v all
end

function __tachy_prev
    # the complete token before the one being completed
    set -l toks (commandline -opc)
    set -l ct (commandline -ct)
    if test -n "$ct"; and test (count $toks) -gt 1
        set -e toks[-1]
    end
    test "$toks[-1]" = "$argv"
end

function __tachy_completed_positionals
    # how many positionals were fully typed after the command word
    set -l toks (commandline -opc)
    set -l ct (commandline -ct)
    if test -n "$ct"; and test (count $toks) -gt 1
        set -e toks[-1]
    end
    set -l skip 0
    set -l n 0
    set -l seen_cmd 0
    for t in $toks[2..-1]
        if test $skip -eq 1
            set skip 0
            continue
        end
        switch $t
            case -i --inventory --config --identity --address --port --direct-report
                set skip 1
            case '-*'
            case '*'
                if test $seen_cmd -eq 0
                    set seen_cmd 1
                else
                    set n (math $n + 1)
                end
        end
    end
    printf '%d\n' $n
end

function __tachy_at_position
    # completing the Nth positional (1 = the first after the command):
    # zero positionals are complete while the first is being typed
    test (__tachy_completed_positionals) -eq (math $argv[1] - 1)
end

function __tachy_at_min_position
    # completing the Nth positional or beyond
    test (__tachy_completed_positionals) -ge (math $argv[1] - 1)
end

# no default file completion: every position that wants files opts in
# explicitly (the option values carry -rF)
complete -c tachy -f

# subcommands
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a 'apply a' -d 'Apply the tasks files to the selected hosts'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a 'check c' -d 'Check mode: report would-be changes without applying'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a hosts -d 'Inspect hosts: "hosts list [<selection>]", "hosts info <host>"'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a 'generate g' -d 'Write scaffolding: keys, samples, shell completions'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a webui -d 'Start a local web console'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a webdoc -d 'Serve the built-in documentation as a web site'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a man -d 'Print the full manual'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a 'version v' -d 'Print the version (the build date)'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a upgrade -d 'Upgrade tachy to the latest GitHub release'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_use_subcommand' -a help -d 'Show help'

# options (global; they may appear before and after the command)
complete -c tachy -s i -l inventory -rF -d 'Inventory file (default: inventory.pravic)'
complete -c tachy -s v -l verbose -d 'Show executed commands, change details and command output'
complete -c tachy -l color -d 'Force colored statuses even when stdout is not a tty'
complete -c tachy -l direct -d 'Apply tasks files directly in this process'
complete -c tachy -l direct-report -rF -d 'With --direct: write "ok changed failed" counters to PATH'
complete -c tachy -l events -d 'Print one JSON event per line on stdout (machine mode)'
complete -c tachy -l keep-bundle -d 'Keep each host temporary bundle after the run'
complete -c tachy -l config -rF -d 'Optional config file'
complete -c tachy -l identity -rF -d 'Age identity for { age = ... } inventory vars'
complete -c tachy -l address -r -d 'Webui/webdoc bind address (default 127.0.0.1)'
complete -c tachy -l port -r -d 'Webui/webdoc port'
complete -c tachy -l completion -d 'Hosts list: print selection candidates for completions'
complete -c tachy -s y -l yes -d 'Upgrade: skip the y/N confirmation'
complete -c tachy -s h -l help -d 'Show help'

# subcommand positionals
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_seen_subcommand_from apply check; and __tachy_at_position 1' -a '(__tachy_candidates)' -d 'selection: all, host or @tag (comma-separated)'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_seen_subcommand_from apply check; and __tachy_at_min_position 2' -a '(__fish_complete_path (commandline -ct))'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_seen_subcommand_from hosts; and __tachy_at_position 1' -a 'list info'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_seen_subcommand_from hosts; and __tachy_prev info' -a '(__tachy_names)' -d 'host'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_seen_subcommand_from hosts; and __tachy_prev list' -a '(__tachy_candidates)'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_seen_subcommand_from generate; and __tachy_at_position 1' -a 'key task config project completions'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_seen_subcommand_from generate; and __tachy_prev completions' -a 'bash zsh fish'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_seen_subcommand_from generate; and __fish_prev_arg_in key task config project' -a '(__fish_complete_path (commandline -ct))'
complete -c tachy -n '__fish_prev_arg_in help' -a 'apply check hosts generate webui webdoc man version upgrade help'
